serialization.digest: sha256(utf-8 canonical json of digest payload; observed_at/deadline_at excluded)
serialization.idempotency_key: source_idempotency_key when source_event_id set (excludes created_at/content); else content digest
serialization.content_fingerprint: digest payload minus created_at when source_event_id set; used for conflict detection
serialization.float_note: Pinned fixture values must emit identical digit strings cross-language (1700000000.0 not 1.7e9). Rust parity measured: 129/129 pass with serde_json float_roundtrip plus explicit key sorting (see golden/lifecycle-event-v1/README.md).
